listing.name: Disco.Balls 1.1.c - More Lamp Colour Options
listing.summary: Adds the option to make your lamp play Carameldansen and go disco, and adds more colours to the selection.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a mechanic where paying tithes to a Luddic Path fleet stops all pather fleets in the system from harassing the player.

description:
These are my mods that do not have their own thread:

I've made a bunch of things that are too small to deserve their own threads over the years, so here goes.

[0.98a] Useful.Tithes

A small mod making pather tithes more useful.

Paying tithes to a luddic path fleet causes all pather fleets in the star system to stop harassing you for a while, including newly spawned fleets and any fleets entering the system.

Download

Safe to add to ongoing games.

[0.98a] Big Pilum Energy

Balance is for losers.

Doubles Pilum movement speed because I am terrible at the game and pilum spam is my lifeline.

Download

Safe to add to ongoing games.

[0.98a] Lost.Sector

A mod focused on exploration and quest content.

This is my

LOST_SECTOR

fork. Made in 0.97 for personal use to fix some of the issues that had been bugging me, with the departure of Kissa from the modding scene, I decided to publish it - with permission.

Download

Requires a new game.

[0.98a] Disco.Balls

More orbital lamp colour options.

Adds the option to make your lamp play Carameldansen and go disco, and adds more colours to the selection. This is a thinly veiled meme.

Known issue:

Loading a save while the song is playing makes it play twice (and twice as loud). This is a feature and will not be fixed.

Download

Safe to add to ongoing games.

These are mods that do have their own thread, but I ran out of space in my signature for:

[0.98a] Corrupt.Officials

This is a challenge mode intended to balance out the extreme passive income colonies can provide.

The mechanic imposes a diminishing-returns penalty on colonies whose net income exceeds a configurable cutoff.

Forum Thread

Safe to add to ongoing games.
